review_comment: §5.1 „არ გამჟღავნდება' and §5.2 „უარის კონკრეტული მიზეზები კლიენტს არ განემარტება' conflict with the duty „უნდა იძლეოდეს ახსნისა და ინტერპრეტაციის შესაძლებლობას'. Caveat: the regulation’s testing step (logic, technical content, bias) is internal and §5.1 only bars disclosure to clients and third parties, so the conflict is mainly about explainability. The proposal makes the technical content ‘available for verification’, which does not fix the §5.2 problem, and the document has no explainability requirement for complex models.

§5.1 „არ გამჟღავნდება' and §5.2 „უარის კონკრეტული მიზეზები კლიენტს არ განემარტება' directly conflict with the duty to increase transparency and be able to explain decision logic to the customer. The proposal restores the explanation duty while keeping the trade secret, which matches the gold fix, though it does not introduce reason codes.

The regulation requires the entity, when needed, to be able to explain the decision logic to the customer, but §5.2 states „უარის კონკრეტული მიზეზები კლიენტს არ განემარტება'. The finding largely duplicates Finding 2. The proposal merely restates the regulation and says nothing about how it fits with §5.1/§5.2.

The document has no requirement that staff qualification match model complexity; §7 gives the validation team only a variable-list check against 4.1. The regulation says „პერსონალის ტექნიკური ცოდნის დონე და კვალიფიკაცია შესაბამისობაში უნდა იყოს მოდელის სირთულესთან', so the gap is real.

The document contains no model ranking or risk-based grouping and no mention of materiality (§8.1 only covers review frequency). The regulation requires a ranking methodology that takes materiality and model-use risk into account. The proposal is generic and omits materiality in its heading, but it is acceptable. Whether an ethics guideline should carry this duty at all is arguable, since it belongs more to the risk policy POL-RM-014.

review_unsupported_claims: The proposal heading ‘3.6’ is invented, although §3 has only 3.1-3.5.
review_comment: The document has no ongoing monitoring/testing programme or benchmark comparison; the regulation says „უნდა შემუშავდეს მიმდინარე ტესტირებისა და მოდელის ადეკვატურობის შეფასების პროგრამა'. This is a validation-framework duty that an ethics guideline may not be expected to contain, hence the scope is unclear.

The document has no pre-launch approval or restricted-launch rule when data are insufficient (regulation: „მოდელის გაშვება უნდა მოხდეს შესაბამისი შეზღუდვებით'). The duty is addressed to the approving body and sits in the risk policy, so its place in an ethics guideline is questionable. The proposal copies the regulation without naming the decision-maker.

review_unsupported_claims: The proposal says the person or body is ‘indicated in the first clause of the guideline’, but the guideline names no approving body (its §1 is scope only).
review_comment: The document contains no regular reporting to the launch-approving body (regulation: „რეგულარული ანგარიშგება უნდა ხორციელდებოდეს'); §3.3 gives only an owner’s accountability. The proposal refers to a body that the document never names, which is a false cross-reference.

The regulation says the entity 'შეუძლია' (may) outsource, and the duty is to follow outsourcing principles when it does. The document never mentions outsourcing, so the gap is real, but the obligation should have been framed as conditional. The duty belongs in the operational-risk/model-risk policy more than an ethics guideline, and 'new_document' is an oversized fix for one sentence.

review_unsupported_claims: Proposal heading ‘3.5.1’ is invented. The proposal merely repeats the regulation without defining what a stricter standard means.
review_comment: The regulation says third-party model risk management 'უნდა ექვემდებარებოდეს უფრო მკაცრ სტანდარტებს', a general risk-management duty with no ethics content. An ethics guideline need not carry it, so absence is not a real gap. If forced to choose, the document is silent, so 'none' would be the literal verdict.

review_unsupported_claims: Claims the document contains no monitoring or elimination of bias; actually §4.1/§4.2 and §7 touch bias, though only as a banned-variable list. Also says the document is only about ethical principles, which is false for a duty that sits squarely in art. 9¹ (ethics).
review_comment: The document has no monitoring of identifiable bias in data processing; the validators only check the variable list against §4.1 ('ვალიდაციისას ცვლადების სიის შემოწმება'). The verdict matches, but the rationale wrongly treats the topic as out of scope for an ethics document, and no evidence clause is cited. Gold concerns a broader set (proxy variables §4.2, accuracy as primary goal §3.2), of which this finding captures only the monitoring gap.

review_unsupported_claims: The obligation drops the 'all model types' element yet the rationale then claims it as missing. The second evidence item cites ‘§—’, a non-existent section number. The document does not claim to be the internal policy, so ‘partial’ compliance is overstated.
review_comment: The regulation addresses 'შიდა პოლიტიკა-პროცედურები' (the bank’s internal policies and procedures), which here is POL-RM-014, referenced in §1.1; an ethics guideline is not that document. Citing §1.1 and the role table as partial coverage is a stretch, and the proposal puts a duty about ‘internal policies’ into the guideline’s purpose clause.

§2 cites „2018 წლის 9 ივლისის №154/04 ბრძანებით დამტკიცებული ეთიკის პრინციპებისა და პროფესიული ქცევის სტანდარტების კოდექსი', whereas the regulation requires the 2021 №13/04 code; this quote exists and the facts are right. Proposal swaps the reference to №13/04, matching the gold fix, but drops the old code without justification; and the first half of the duty (developing own ethics principles) is met by the document itself.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence cites ‘§—’ instead of §7; the claim is only about terminology, not substance.
review_comment: The §7 table gives „მოდელის შემმუშავებელი' only variable-selection duties and documentation; nowhere is responsibility for model building and testing assigned to the first line of defence. The gap is a missing assignment, not just missing terminology, although the proposal adds the first-line wording and building/testing duty.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence quote is empty (''') with section ‘§—’, so no clause is actually cited. The claim that the document already requires variable documentation as a partial match is stretched: variable-list documentation (§7) is not ‘model documentation’ as a risk factor. The proposal gives developers a task the regulation assigns to the ranking methodology.
review_comment: The regulation item „მოდელთან დაკავშირებული დოკუმენტაცია' is a single factor in the model risk ranking methodology (art. 6 ¶4¹ ბ.დ), which cannot be assessed on its own and is not an ethics-guideline matter. Partial is not defensible when no clause is cited; the right result is no finding (a gap, if any, is already covered by Finding 5).

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence quote is empty and section ‘§—’; says the document ‘mentions’ the validation group’s responsibility but that is a different duty (variable-list check), unrelated to proportionality.
review_comment: The duty „იყენებს პროპორციულობის პრინციპს მოდელის მნიშვნელობიდან და სირთულიდან გამომდინარე' concerns the conduct of the second line’s validation, a matter for the model-risk policy rather than an ethics guideline. The document’s validation-group row concerns only a check against §4.1, so ‘partial’ is not supported; at most the document is silent. The proposal forces a proportionality duty into an unrelated role row.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence cites ‘§—’ for the role table instead of §7. The claim that the document ‘does not mention the acquisition context’ is correct. Calling §3.3 a partial match is generous, since §3.3 only requires a named owner.
review_comment: §3.3 „თითოეულ მოდელს ჰყავს განსაზღვრული მფლობელი, რომელიც პასუხს აგებს' covers owner accountability for every model, which largely satisfies the sentence that the entity is owner and responsible for an acquired model. What is missing is only the acquisition case and the further duties of art. 9 ¶2 (own development/documentation policy, knowing the technical side and logic), which the finding does not address. The proposal just copies the regulation into §3.3 and is acceptable.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says accuracy ‘and legality’ are principles that nearly address the duty. §3.2 does not address error-driven bias at all; it is an accuracy goal, not bias prevention. The proposal bolts the regulation’s sentence onto the accuracy principle without any mechanism.
review_comment: Nothing in the document deals with deviation: §3 has no principle of avoiding deviation ('გადახრისგან თავის არიდება') and no definition or typology of it, so ‘partial’ on the basis of §3.2 'სიზუსტე' is too generous; ‘none’ fits better. Gold stresses the missing principles of avoiding deviation and transparency and the missing typology, which the finding only touches indirectly, and the proposed fix adds neither.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says the document leaves no rule for priority ‘when accuracy and social neutrality conflict’, which is slightly off: the document does not just omit the rule but declares accuracy the primary criterion (§3.2). The §4.1 quote is abbreviated with an ellipsis but is genuine.
review_comment: §3.2 states „სიზუსტე წარმოადგენს მოდელის შერჩევის მთავარ კრიტერიუმს' and calls accuracy the „უპირველესი მიზანი', which conflicts with giving priority to socially neutral outcomes whenever accuracy does not fall significantly; the system sees the right clause but only labels it ‘partial’. §4.1 only bans protected attributes and is not a priority rule. The proposal adds the regulation’s condition to §3.2 and matches the gold fix, though it still keeps accuracy as the ‘main criterion’.

F4 states „M-002 (საზედამხედველო მოდელი) გამოიყენება 01.06.2021-დან; ... განაცხადი წარდგენილია 10.08.2021“, i.e. use began about 2.5 months before the consent application, which conflicts with the duty of prior consent („წინასწარ თანხმობას“). The verdict is correct, but the proposal only appends a note and keeps the risk rating 'medium'; the gold fix wants F4 re-rated high and the 5.2 conclusion corrected. The system did not flag the rating or conclusion understatement.

F6 says „ბანკს არ აქვს მოდელების რისკის დონის მიხედვით კლასიფიკაციის (tiering) მეთოდოლოგია“ and that this „შეესაბამება დებულებას“; art6/p4.1 (effective 2022-05-03) requires a ranking methodology and a risk-based approach, so the audit conclusion is wrong. The proposal's table rewrite changes the F6 text but still gives no risk rating or recommendation (the gold fix asks for a finding with a recommendation), and it recopies F1–F5 unchanged.

The obligation „უნდა შეიმუშაოს ... რანჟირების/დაჯგუფების მეთოდოლოგია“ is faithful, and F6 confirms the bank has none, so the document's conclusion of compliance contradicts it. The proposal rewrites F6 as a bare statement of absence and drops the rating and recommendation, so it does not yet fix the finding. It also duplicates the previous finding.

review_unsupported_claims: Treats uniform validation intensity as breaching proportionality in art6/p6, whereas the more direct basis is art6/p4.1–p4.2.
review_comment: F6 states „ვალიდაციის ინტენსივობა ყველა მოდელისთვის ერთნაირია“, which conflicts with the duty to apply proportionality by model importance and complexity (art6/p6, 'პროპორციულობის პრინციპს'). The conflict is real, though p6 addresses the second line's final conclusion and the real basis is p4.2, and the finding largely repeats the F6 findings above. The F6 text only becomes non-compliant from 2022, while this obligation is dated 2021-01-01.

review_unsupported_claims: §5.2 is cited as partial support, but its wording „აუდიტი დაადასტურებს“ is a loose claim. The rationale's 'contradicts' combines the exclusion with an otherwise partial position.
review_comment: §2.2 excludes „მოდელების განახლების (ხელახალი კალიბრაციის) დოკუმენტაცია“, while §2.1 covers building and validation documentation, so the documentation duty is only partly met. The missing element is update documentation, which makes 'partial' more exact than 'contradicts'. The proposal's wording 'არ უნდა გამოირიცხოს' is a rule-like phrase rather than a scope change, and it lumps in the validation timeliness exclusion, which is a different duty.

§2.2 excludes „მოდელების მიერ გამოყენებული საოპერაციო სისტემები და მონაცემთა მართვა“ and defers it to a 2023 IT audit, while art7/p2 says the third line „უნდა შეაფასოს“ them. The quote is accurate and the verdict is right. The proposal brings both into scope, which matches the gold fix.

F1 notes „მომწოდებლის ანგარიში არ შეიცავს მოდელის შეზღუდვებისა და დაშვებების აღწერას“, so the third party did not supply the limitations and assumptions required by art9/p4. The audit reports this fact as a finding, but the bank still relied on that report, which fits the 'contradicts' verdict. The proposal keeps the high rating and adds a request for documentation from the supplier, which fits the rationale.

review_unsupported_claims: The proposal adds an audit-report section that restates a regulatory duty of the model user.
review_comment: The duty „დაასაბუთოს ამ ცვლილების საჭიროება“ for changes to a supervisory model belongs to the model user, not an audit report, which has no such duty and whose scope did not cover supervisory model changes. The proposed section 'მოდელის ცვლილების დასაბუთება' would be a policy-style duty copied into an audit report. The gold label (understated F3/F4 ratings) addresses a different problem, so the system's reasoning does not match it.

The duty „დაცვის მეორე ხაზმა უნდა აცნობოს პირველ ხაზს" is an operating duty of the second line, not something an internal audit report must state; F1 even records an unperformed validation. The proposed section 3.4 would put a policy duty into an audit report. The gold label (RAMD analysts who built M-001 helped with recalculations, §3.2, an independence problem) is a different issue and the system did not see it.

„უნდა მოხდეს ... ალტერნატიულ თეორიებთან შედარება" is a first-line model-building duty; an audit report need not describe it, so its absence is not a gap. The proposed section 4.1 copies the regulation into the audit report.

„უნდა შეფასდეს ... თვისებრივი ინფორმაცია, მსჯელობა და ლოგიკა" is a duty of the second-line internal validation, not of the third-line audit report. Whether the audit tested validation documentation is covered in §2.1, so this is not an audit gap, and the proposed 4.1 section would put the validators' duty into the report.

The duty to run additional analysis when results differ from the benchmark model („საორიენტაციო მოდელს შორის განსხვავების") is a monitoring/validation procedure, not an audit-report content item. An audit report that does not describe it has no gap, and the proposed addition is a misplaced duty.

„მოდელის რისკის მნიშვნელოვანი ცვლილებები ... უნდა გახდეს მოდელის გამოყენების შეზღუდვის ან შეჩერების საფუძველი" is a duty of the model user's governance and policy. An audit report does not need to state it, and the proposal turns a regulatory duty into a statement in the report.

„მოდელის გამომყენებელი სუბიექტი არის მოდელის მესაკუთრე და პასუხისმგებელი პირი" is a status and policy duty of the bank, not a duty of an audit report. The report's silence on ownership is not a gap, and the proposed section merely copies the regulation into the report.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says the report does not address unavailable third-party documentation; F1 does address the lack of supplier limitations/assumptions and the reliance on the vendor report.
review_comment: The duty „მოდელის გამომყენებელ სუბიექტს უნდა გააჩნდეს საკუთარი მონაცემები ... ტესტირება მის შეძენამდე" belongs to the bank as model user, not to the audit report. The audit's F1 already reports the related M-007 problem, and the proposed section 2.3 would insert a bank duty into the audit scope.

review_unsupported_claims: The 'missing' element about confirming that all models state limitations and assumptions is not in art5/p10.1; the system's evidence is only loosely related to transparency. Evidence quote at §5.1 is accurate.
review_comment: The audit concludes „პოლიტიკა და მმართველობითი სტრუქტურა ზოგადად შეესაბამება დებულების მოთხოვნებს" while §2.1–§3.1 contain no test of transparency or explainability (art5/p10.1, in force from 2022), so the audit confirms compliance only in part, matching the gold point that explainability, ethics and deviation tests are absent. The system reaches this through the vendor-report gap, which is a weaker link than the missing audit test, and the proposal only adds a gap sentence to the conclusion instead of an audit procedure.

„შიდა ვალიდაციის პროცედურამ უნდა მოიცვას მოდელის თითოეული კომპონენტი" is a duty of the second-line validation procedure, not of the third-line audit report. The audit's scope in §2.1 covers validation documentation, so there is no audit gap here. The proposal attributes to the audit scope a component-by-component coverage that the audit never claimed, and the gold note says findings on art. 6 F1/F2 are correct and should not be treated as wrong.

review_unsupported_claims: The obligation sentence says back-testing is done in parallel when the model is updated, which is accurate, but it is a validator's duty; the system treats the audit's recalculation (§3.1) as a partial match for it.
review_comment: „მოდელის განახლებისას პარალელურად უნდა განხორციელდეს შედეგების ანალიზი ... (back-testing)" is an internal validation procedure of the second line. The audit's §3.1 'ხელახალი გაანგარიშება' is the audit's own test method and does not need to mirror it. The proposal would claim the audit performed back-testing, which the document does not show.

art7/p1 says the third line must make sure „შიდა ვალიდაცია შესრულებულია დროულად", yet §2.2 expressly excludes „ვალიდაციის დროულობის შეფასება", so the audit conflicts with the duty rather than meeting it in part. The system rightly spotted the exclusion, but 'partial' understates it. The proposal only re-lists the exclusions with a bracket saying the topic is in scope, which leaves the text self-contradictory and does not move timeliness into scope.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence cites F1 (M-007 internal validation not done) as partial support for launching with restrictions, which concerns a different matter; the rationale also mentions 'დროებითი ნებართვა' as supporting the process, which is only F3.
review_comment: „მოდელის გაშვება უნდა მოხდეს შესაბამისი შეზღუდვებით" is a duty of the launch decision-maker, not content an audit report must state. F1 concerns missing validation, not launch restrictions, so it is the wrong clause. The proposal inserts a regulatory sentence into a finding. The gold issue (F3/F4 rated only medium and §5.2 stating compliance) is a different problem that the system did not see.

review_unsupported_claims: Rationale calls the RAMD analysts 'second line' staff; the document only says they are from RAMD's credit scoring group and took part in building M-001, which makes them first-line model developers. The §3.3 outsourcing point is missed.
review_comment: §3.2 says analysts who „მონაწილეობდნენ M-001 მოდელის აგებაში" supported the audit's recalculation, which breaches the independence of the lines, and §3.3 shows an outsourced partner who had advised on M-003 and was chosen by simplified procurement. The document states conflicting facts, so 'contradicts' fits better than 'partial'. The proposal inserts an unsupported statement that independence 'was preserved', which would invent a fact the document contradicts.

review_unsupported_claims: The cited §5.2 is read as evidence of partial compliance with data-bias monitoring, but it only concerns building and validation processes in general terms.
review_comment: „გადახრის მონიტორინგი და ... აღმოფხვრა" is an operating duty of the model user, not a content item of an audit report. The real gap is that the audit scope has no test of the ethics, bias and explainability requirements that apply from 2022 (gold D10-07); the system's proposal instead puts the bank's duty into §5.2.

review_unsupported_claims: §5.2 is cited as partial support, though it does not mention monitoring or bias at all.
review_comment: „მიმდინარე მონიტორინგის პროცესში მოდელში გადახრის არსებობის შემოწმება" is a duty of the model user's monitoring, not of the audit report. As in the previous finding, the real audit gap is the missing test of ethics, bias and explainability compliance in the scope (gold D10-07); the proposal wrongly writes a monitoring methodology into the audit conclusion.

§4.2 says „ვალიდაციის ჯგუფს არ აქვს შესაძლებლობა, დამოუკიდებლად შეაფასოს მოდელის შესრულება“, which conflicts directly with the second line's duty to assess independently and validate. The proposal rewrites the report to claim full access exists, which is not a remediation and states a fact that is not true.

review_unsupported_claims: Rationale adds that missing score access impairs 'validation'; that part of the claim is not the transparency requirement itself.
review_comment: §4.2 „ბანკს არ აქვს წვდომა მოდელის რისკის ქულებზე, მხოლოდ საბოლოო გადაწყვეტილებაზე“ means the model cannot be explained or interpreted, against „უნდა იძლეოდეს ახსნისა და ინტერპრეტაციის შესაძლებლობას“. The inference is somewhat indirect, since the clause also concerns the testing stage, but it is sound. The proposal restates the regulation and adds an access duty.

review_unsupported_claims: Equates PSI above the red threshold with the model being 'unstable'; the regulation speaks of instability found in robustness testing.
review_comment: §2.2.1 reports PSI 0.27 above the red threshold and §2.3.1 says „მოდელი რჩება გამოყენებაში შეზღუდვების გარეშე“, which conflicts with the duty to restrict use when the model is found unstable. The link between population drift (PSI) and the clause's extreme-value stability testing is a stretch, but it is reasonable. The proposal appends a restriction duty without naming a concrete restriction.

review_unsupported_claims: Rationale says validation has no access to 'detailed model data' and the §3.2.1 citation is weak; §4.2 only concerns scores.
review_comment: With no score access (§4.2), the second line cannot verify data or re-run the model and compare results, as the clause requires. The §3.2.1 citation as 'partial' is weak. The proposal largely restates the regulation.

§3.2.1 reports missing values at 12.4% and §3.2.2 says „მოდელი რჩება გამოყენებაში შეზღუდვების გარეშე“, so a data deficiency is paired with unrestricted use, against 'გაშვება უნდა მოხდეს შესაბამისი შეზღუდვებით'. The proposal simply says 'with appropriate restrictions' without specifying them, though that is what the regulation requires.

review_unsupported_claims: Treats a PSI red-zone reading and 12.4% missing values as a 'risk appetite breach'; the document never mentions risk appetite. The obligation also drops the 'significant changes in model risk' limb.
review_comment: The decisive words are „მოდელი რჩება გამოყენებაში შეზღუდვების გარეშე“ (§2.3.1, §3.2.2) after red-zone indicators, which conflicts with 'მოდელის რისკის მნიშვნელოვანი ცვლილებები ... უნდა გახდეს ... შეზღუდვის ... საფუძველი'. The system frames it as a risk appetite breach, which the document does not support, and the proposal asserts that equivalence.

review_unsupported_claims: Only test results are evidenced; the development/validation description and limitations are not addressed in the document.
review_comment: §4.1 says the SLA „არ ითვალისწინებს მომწოდებლის ვალდებულებას, რეგულარულად წარმოადგინოს მოდელის ტესტირების შედეგები“, which conflicts with the third-party duty to present test results. The proposal restates the regulation and does not propose a contract amendment.

§4.1 „კვარტალური შესრულების ანგარიში 2021 წლის IV და 2022 წლის I კვარტლისთვის არ მიუღიათ“ together with the SLA lacking any reporting duty shows the bank is not regularly receiving the vendor's test results. The proposal adds contract revision, which fits the cited gap, though it does not mention internal monitoring.

review_unsupported_claims: The cited §4.2 sentence is about the validation group's ability to assess performance independently, not about checking vendor test results against risk appetite. Since no vendor results are received (§4.1), nothing exists to check, so 'contradicts' is a stretch.
review_comment: The document never mentions risk appetite, and §4.1 shows no vendor test results are received, so this limb is unmet rather than contradicted. The cited §4.2 „არ აქვს შესაძლებლობა, დამოუკიდებლად შეაფასოს“ concerns independent validation, not the appetite check. The proposal merely restates the gap in the report and adds the invented duty to check; it does not fix anything.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence line claims the bank 'has no resource' to verify the model; §4.2 says it has no access to scores and the validation group cannot independently assess, which is close but not literally about resources.
review_comment: §4.1 shows the vendor does not report, and §4.2 „ვალიდაციის ჯგუფს არ აქვს შესაძლებლობა, დამოუკიდებლად შეაფასოს მოდელის შესრულება“ shows the bank cannot self-verify, which conflicts with 'უნდა გააჩნდეს რესურსი თავად შეამოწმოს'. The proposal rewrites the finding as a statement of fact with a vague 'self-monitoring resources' phrase and copies the operational figures without fixing anything.

review_unsupported_claims: Obligation drops the second duty in the regulation ('დაასაბუთოს ახალი საზედამხედველო მოდელის უპირატესობა').
review_comment: The duty applies when a new supervisory model replacing an old one is presented to the National Bank. A quarterly monitoring report neither presents such models nor has any replacement in play, so a 'none' gap is not meaningful. The proposed new section 2.2 would also be misplaced in the report.

review_unsupported_claims: Obligation omits the documentation duty and the data-suitability/methodology-fit sentence of the regulation. The proposal heading is placed at 3.2.3, a section about a post-migration data incident.
review_comment: The duty falls on first-line model building: „მოდელის აგების ეტაპზე უნდა შეფასდეს“. The system itself notes the document is a monitoring report, which is not where build-stage data assessment is documented, so reporting a gap is not valid. The proposal merely restates the regulation as report text.

The duty concerns data-quality methodology, normally set in internal policy-procedures (compare art5/p6), not a quarterly monitoring report. Treating its absence as a gap is wrong, and proposing a 'new_document' for a report is not a fix to the report.

„მოდელთან დაკავშირებული დოკუმენტაცია“ is one factor in the model-ranking methodology that the entity must build for risk-based validation planning, a policy-level matter. A monitoring report has no obligation to list it, so 'none' is not a real gap.

„მოდელების ურთიერთდამოკიდებულება“ is a component of the risk-ranking methodology for validation planning, not content a periodic monitoring report must carry. Its absence is not a compliance gap in this document.

review_unsupported_claims: Obligation says 'კომერციული ბანკისა და მიკრობანკის' for a document that belongs to a commercial bank; fine, but the duty is the Supervisory Board's own assurance, not something a report must describe. This version of the provision also dates from 2023-07-01, after the report period (Q1 2022).
review_comment: „სამეთვალყურეო საბჭოს წევრები უნდა დარწმუნდნენ“ is a governance duty of the board, not a content requirement for a monitoring report. The report's distribution to the CRO, committee and directorate in §7.1 is not meant to evidence it, and the 2023 effective date postdates the report. Treating this as a gap is not valid.

review_unsupported_claims: The obligation assigns the fit determination to the third party ('მესამე მხარემ უნდა განისაზღვროს'); the regulation's passive 'უნდა განისაზღვროს' leaves the determination to the model user after the vendor presents its materials. The proposal repeats the same error.
review_comment: The regulation says „ამის შემდეგ უნდა განისაზღვროს, არის თუ არა მოდელი ... მიზანშეწონილი“, a decision the bank makes at acquisition, not a vendor duty. A quarterly monitoring report would not record it. The real problem in the document (§4.1, the vendor supplies no test results) belongs to the first limb of art9/p4, already covered by Finding 7, so this is a misstated, out-of-scope obligation.

The duty is to increase decision-logic transparency and to be able to explain decisions to customers 'საჭიროების შემთხვევაში'. That is a policy and process obligation, not content a monitoring report must contain. The one transparency problem in the document (§4.2, no score access for M-005) is already raised under art5/p10.1.

review_unsupported_claims: Obligation concerns supervisory models whose changes are reported to the National Bank; M-001 is not shown to be a supervisory model, and the document never says it is. The claim that §2.2.3 'describes the reason and the result' as a change needing supervisory justification is unsupported. The proposal also asserts 'error analysis confirmed the change improves the model', which is invented.
review_comment: art11/p5 applies to supervisory models and sets a duty toward the National Bank: „ვალდებულია დაასაბუთოს ამ ცვლილების საჭიროება“. §2.2.3 only records a lowered approval threshold; nothing marks M-001 as supervisory. The proposal fabricates a conclusion not in the document.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence cites a quote with an empty string („“) and sections '§—'. PSI is population stability monitoring, not the robustness testing described in art5/p10; calling it 'behaviour under changes of input parameters' is a stretch. The required scenario testing is conditional ('საჭიროების შემთხვევაში').
review_comment: „მოდელის განვითარების აუცილებელი ეტაპია ტესტირება“ is a development-stage first-line duty, not something a quarterly monitoring report documents. The evidence is malformed (an empty quotation, no section) and the proposal inserts development-testing text into the report.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence cites section '§—' for a table row. The proposal inserts 'the data conform to the model requirements and the chosen methodology', a statement of compliance that the document does not support and that contradicts §3.2.1 and §3.2.2.
review_comment: Data suitability for the chosen methodology is a build-stage matter ('მოდელის აგების ეტაპზე'). The monitoring report in fact discloses the 12.4% missing-value deficiency, which belongs to art8/p1. The proposal asserts fitness for purpose right after a data incident, which would be a false statement.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence quotes carry no section ('§—') and the second quote is described as covering the 'IFRS 9' model when it is the M-001 table. Claims stability and accuracy are only 'partially' shown, yet the report shows Gini (accuracy), PSI (stability) and actual/predicted ratios (calibration); the drift gap is not a requirement of the report. The proposal invents an empty 'Drift' row with placeholders.
review_comment: The clause lists factors for the entity's risk-ranking methodology for validation planning, not content for a monitoring report. In any case the report covers stability („სტაბილურობა (PSI)“) and accuracy (Gini) at length, so 'partial' is unwarranted.

review_unsupported_claims: §5.1 concerns the justification of expert adjustments, not qualitative evaluation of the information used in model development; the link is forced.
review_comment: The duty concerns conceptual-soundness review of the qualitative information and reasoning used in model development (validation scope), which is not a monitoring-report requirement. The system cites §5.1, „კორექტირებების 92% დასაბუთებულია“, which the expert key marks as a compliant section that should not be flagged. The proposal adds an unsupported claim that such an evaluation took place.

review_unsupported_claims: Reuses the same §5.1 evidence as the previous finding; it is a duplicate of the second sentence of art6/p5/sა.გ. The proposal asserts the procedure 'is argued and properly documented', with no basis in the document.
review_comment: This is the validation-process assurance duty for qualitative review; the report neither performs nor describes it. §5.1 is marked as a compliant section that should not be flagged. The proposed text merely declares compliance without evidence.

review_unsupported_claims: Second evidence item quotes an empty string („“) for §3.2.2 and claims 'management took corrective action' as evidence of being informed. The report itself, addressed to the CRO, the Models Committee and the Directorate (§7.1) and stating the data incident (§3.2.1) and the +3% management overlay (§3.2.2), arguably does inform decision-makers, so the 'partial' gap is weak. The rationale also ignores the decisive problem, which is unrestricted use.
review_comment: The inform limb is plausibly met (§3.2.1 discloses „12,4%-მდე გაიზარდა“; §7.1 sends the report to the CRO, committee and directorate), while the same clause's second limb is violated by §3.2.2 „მოდელი რჩება გამოყენებაში შეზღუდვების გარეშე“ against 'გაშვება უნდა მოხდეს შესაბამისი შეზღუდვებით'. The system targets the weaker limb and misses the real gap (the same one reported in Finding 5). The proposal inserts an unsupported assertion that the decision-maker 'was directly informed'.

review_unsupported_claims: Says the document lacks a 'mechanism or policy' for turning changes into restrictions; a monitoring report is not where such a policy sits, and the real issue is that the stated decisions conflict with the duty. §4.3 'მოდელი რჩება გამოყენებაში' concerns M-005 and is not a significant risk change.
review_comment: §2.2.1 PSI 0.27 above red with the ratio at 1.46 in the digital channel, and §2.3.1 „მოდელი რჩება გამოყენებაში შეზღუდვების გარეშე“, together with 12.4% missing values and §3.2.2 unrestricted use, show significant changes in model risk that did not lead to restriction or suspension, which is a contradiction rather than a partial. The proposal is a generic restatement and its second sentence ('the validation group ensures the mechanism operates') invents a role and does not require a concrete restriction or escalation.
§5.3 says „გამოიყენება ბოლო 3 წლის მონაცემები“, while the regulation requires „სულ მცირე ხუთ წელს“. The obligation leaves out the insufficient-history exception, but the proposal restores it.

§5.4 sets „დეტალური პერიოდი შეადგენს 12 თვეს“, against the regulation's „არაუმცირეს სამი წლისა“. The proposal keeps the 'last year's actual losses' tail, which art11/p2 would replace with a long-term historical average, so the fix is only partly aligned.

review_unsupported_claims: Rationale says the document states macro conditions are not considered at all; §2.3 only excludes macroeconomic deterioration.
review_comment: §2.3 „მაკროეკონომიკური გარემოს გაუარესება ამ შეფასებისას არ განიხილება“ conflicts with the duty to reflect „მიმდინარე, ასევე საპროგნოზო“ economic conditions. The system slightly overstates the clause as excluding the whole macro environment.

§2.2 moves an instrument to Stage 2 only at „60 დღეზე მეტით“, so 31–60 days past due can stay in Stage 1, against the 30-day limit. The proposal ignores the art4/p6 technical-delay exception, but the document contains no such exception either.
§2.3 „მაკროეკონომიკური გარემოს გაუარესება ამ შეფასებისას არ განიხილება“ excludes exactly what art5/p2 requires the Stage 2 assessment to rest on.

§2.6 „მე-3 დონეს მიეკუთვნება მხოლოდ ეს ინსტრუმენტი; მსესხებლის სხვა ინსტრუმენტები ინარჩუნებს თავის კატეგორიას“ is the opposite of borrower-level contamination. The proposal copies the regulation verbatim, including the reference to 'ამ წესის 23-ე მუხლი', which does not fit the bank's own methodology.
§4.1 writes off the unsecured part after „540 დღეზე მეტი“, against the regulation's 360 days, and the bank states it has no write-off policy of its own, so the default applies.
§4.1 „სრულად უზრუნველყოფილი ინსტრუმენტი ... – 1 080 დღის შემდეგ“ exceeds the regulation's 720 days for the secured part.

review_unsupported_claims: The evidence quote from §3.1 is cut off. The full clause says the Stage 2 to Stage 1 move happens after one timely payment and that no financial analysis is required, so the substance is right. The rationale does not mention §3.3, which also allows Stage 3 to Stage 1 after three payments with no analysis stated.
review_comment: §3.1 says „მსესხებლის ფინანსური ანალიზი ამ შემთხვევაში არ მოითხოვება“, which conflicts with art8/p1 requiring any upgrade to be „ფინანსურ ანალიზზე“ based. §3.3 (Stage 3 to Stage 1 after three payments, no analysis mentioned) is also non-compliant but was not cited. The proposal keeps the 'one timely payment' trigger, which also conflicts with art8/p2's three demonstration payments.

review_unsupported_claims: The system claims §5.2 conflicts with the capex duty. §5.2 only restricts the data used („წინა პერიოდის გამოცდილება და ფაქტობრივი ფინანსური მონაცემები“); it does not exclude capex, which is itself a kind of actual financial data. The obligation also drops the „მათ შორის“ framing, which makes the list non-exhaustive.
review_comment: The document never mentions capital or investment expenditure, and §5.2 „გამოიყენება მხოლოდ“ historical and actual data excludes forward-looking planned capex. This is a gap rather than a clean contradiction, though the 'only' wording makes the line arguable. The proposal keeps 'განსხვავებული ეკონომიკური სცენარები არ განიხილება', which conflicts with art9/p5.

review_unsupported_claims: The claim that the document says nothing about data matching the relevant portfolio or homogeneous group is correct. However, the proposal keeps the 3-year period, which conflicts with the five-year requirement in the same paragraph.
review_comment: §5.3 „გამოიყენება ბოლო 3 წლის მონაცემები“ says nothing about portfolio or homogeneous-group representativeness, so 'none' is right for this element. The gold label targets the 3-year versus 5-year conflict, which is a different element of the paragraph, and the proposal re-writes „ბოლო 3 წლის“ and so embeds that conflict.

The document has no clause on separate model building per homogeneous group; §5.3 only mentions PD, LGD and EAD models in general. The proposal covers the first sentence of art13/p1 but not 'ერთი სახის მოდელები და იდენტური პარამეტრები' within a group.

No clause in document.txt mentions model development or validation, or the order №151/04; §6.1 only assigns methodology review to RAMD. The proposal marks the finding as adjust_clause although no existing clause covers it, so add_section would fit better.

The document has no model-update work plan and no mention of reducing reliance on one-off adjustments; §6.1 gives only a quarterly review and a methodology review by RAMD. The proposal restates the duty without inventing deadlines or roles.

art21 governs developing a credit risk rating function (univariate and multivariate analysis), which is a model-development duty. MTH-RM-022 is a provisioning methodology that defines stages and ECL rules and has no rating-scorecard development section, so reporting a gap is probably not warranted. The obligation is also narrowed to just 'სტაბილურობა', one of three criteria in a closed list.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says the document mentions DSCR and Debt/EBITDA indicators; this is true (§2.4), but the document sets no thresholds, and the 'none' verdict does not acknowledge that §2.4 partly touches the topic.
review_comment: §2.4 names DSCR, ICR and „ვალი/EBITDA-ს გაუარესება“ as significant-increase indicators, but there are no 4.5 or 1.2 thresholds and no „10%-იანი ცვლილება“ rule. The topic is touched but the specific element is missing, so 'partial' fits better than 'none'. The proposal copies the regulation's numbers exactly and invents nothing.

document.txt has no clause on collateral valuation, net realizable value or discounting at the effective interest rate; §5 covers only individual assessment, data and scenarios. The rationale's word 'ფორმულა' is slightly stronger than the regulation, which states a calculation principle, and the proposal omits the closing purpose 'წმინდა ანაზღაურებადი ღირებულება'.

The only restructuring text is §3.4 („რესტრუქტურიზებული ... აღარ ჩაითვლება რესტრუქტურიზებულად, თუ ... 6 თვე“), which says nothing about transfer to a new borrower or co-borrower. The proposed heading '5.6' sits under the ECL section although this is a classification rule, so §2 or §3 would fit better.

review_unsupported_claims: The §1.1 quote is cut with an ellipsis. §1.1 is relevant only to the second sentence (a clear methodology), not to governance. The duty in the first sentence falls on the board and management, not necessarily on the methodology text.
review_comment: The methodology defines stages, ECL measurement and a review (§6.1 „რისკების კომიტეტი“, „RAMD“) but never mentions „სამეთვალყურეო საბჭო“, „დირექტორატი“ or internal controls. Scope is debatable because the first sentence is a governance duty, though the second sentence does bear on the methodology. The proposal copies the regulation and invents no roles.

review_unsupported_claims: The 'partial' reading rests on §5.5, which only says scenario information is reflected per scenario. It never names the source of scenarios, so it is weak support for partial compliance.
review_comment: §5.5 „აისახება PD, LGD და EAD პარამეტრებში თითოეული სცენარისთვის ცალ-ცალკე“ concerns how scenarios feed parameters, not whether they come from the National Bank or how own scenarios are justified. Nothing addresses art11/p4, so 'none' fits better than 'partial'. The proposal restates only the first sentence and leaves out the justification of own scenarios.

review_unsupported_claims: The cited §5.2 and §5.5 say nothing about forecast validation, so they do not show partial compliance; the evidence lines themselves admit expert review is not mentioned.
review_comment: No clause in document.txt mentions expert judgment or a reasonableness check of the forecast; §5.2 „მხოლოდ მსესხებლის წინა პერიოდის გამოცდილება“ and §5.5 are unrelated to this duty. 'none' is the accurate verdict, and the proposal restates the duty without inventing details.

§6.1 „მეთოდოლოგიის გადახედვას უზრუნველყოფს ... (RAMD)“ gives a general methodology review, but grouping principles are not named and no regularity is stated, so partial versus none is arguable. The proposal leaves the second sentence of art12/p7 (re-assessment on new information) uncovered and uses the vague 'რეგულარულად' with no frequency.

§2.4 lists „საცალო სესხებისთვის – სესხის მომსახურების კოეფიციენტის (PTI) გაუარესება“ as an indicator, but gives no link to the N44/04 limits and no „10 პროცენტული პუნქტით ცვლილება“ rule. The proposal follows the regulation text closely and invents nothing.

review_unsupported_claims: The obligation turns one of three alternative criteria ('ერთ ან რამდენიმე') into a stand-alone mandatory rule. The proposal text also has a typo ('არ თუ არ').
review_comment: The document defines Stage 2 (§2.1, §2.2) and Stage 3 (§2.5), and Annex 1 lists Stage 1 as „საკრედიტო რისკი მნიშვნელოვნად არ გაზრდილა“. Stage 1 as the remainder follows by implication, and the regulation does not require an explicit residual sentence, so demanding one is too strict.

§4.1 sets only day-count write-off thresholds and never states the principle of 'გადახდის გონივრული მოლოდინი' or the art6/p7 grounds (legally unenforceable, or very small likelihood of recovery). The proposal adds the principle but keeps „540 დღეზე მეტი“ and „1 080 დღის“, which conflict with the 360/720-day defaults in art6/p9, so the fix reintroduces a non-compliant figure.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale and 'missing' field say the problem is the absence of a bank-judgement criterion beyond the capital thresholds. They do not flag that §5.1's 3% threshold itself conflicts with the 1.0% and 0.5% thresholds in art9/p2(ა)-(ბ). The explanation also says the capital threshold was corrected, although the rationale never raised it.
review_comment: §5.1 has only the capital-based triggers, which are wrong at „პირველადი კაპიტალის 3 პროცენტს“, and has no 'bank judges the borrower individually significant' criterion, so art9/p2(დ) is partly missing. The gold label targets the 3% versus 1.0%/0.5% threshold error, which the finding does not state as its main reason. The proposal wrongly sets 0.5% for Stage 1 as well; the regulation gives 1.0% for Stage 1 and 0.5% for high-risk, Stage 2/3 and POCI.

§8.2 states „Random Forest კომპონენტის შიდა ლოგიკა არ ექვემდებარება პირდაპირ ინტერპრეტაციას“, which conflicts with the duty that the model „უნდა იძლეოდეს ახსნისა და ინტერპრეტაციის შესაძლებლობას“. The quote is accurate. The proposal rewrites the regulation's own clause rather than fixing the bank's model (e.g. adding explainability tools such as feature importance), so it does not really remove the conflict.

review_unsupported_claims: Obligation turns an NBG-set deadline (min. 6 months) into the bank's own duty to apply 'within an undefined period'; the rationale says the document does not mention NBG consent, but §6.1 does.
review_comment: The regulation says NBG sets the deadline and the bank must meet the requirements and apply for consent; the obligation garbles this. The document does mention consent (§6.1 „ეროვნული ბანკის თანხმობის მიღების შემდეგ“), so 'none' is wrong, but it also states the model is used since 1 June 2021 (§2) with no consent, which is the real issue the gold identifies (art10/p1/sა, income assessment model). The proposal copies the garbled wording.

The regulation requires internal policies to set the approach to missing and outlier data. §4 lists data sources and §5 the model but nothing on missing/outlier treatment, so 'none' is right. Scope is slightly doubtful, since this is a policy duty and the application need only reflect it, but a model application would normally describe data treatment.

The document does address validation: §6.1 says „მოდელის სრული შიდა ვალიდაცია ჩატარდება ეროვნული ბანკის თანხმობის მიღების შემდეგ“ and defers it to 2022, with only developer testing in the meantime. It never says validation covers inputs, calculation and outputs, so the scope gap is real, but 'none' ignores §6.1; 'partial' fits better (arguably a gap in timing, since no validation has been done).

The duty („მატერიალურობის განსაზღვრის პროცესში … გადაწყვეტილების მიღების პროცესზე ზეგავლენა“) governs the bank's internal validation/model-ranking methodology. A supervisory model application is not the document that must set out materiality criteria, so absence there is not a gap.

The materiality criterion „ფინანსურ და საზედამხედველო ანგარიშგებაზე ზეგავლენა“ belongs to the internal model-ranking methodology, not to a per-model application. The proposed 'add_section' in this document misplaces the duty.

„მოდელების ურთიერთდამოკიდებულება“ is one risk-assessment factor in the bank's validation ranking methodology. It is not required content of this application, and the finding turns a list item into a mandatory section.

review_unsupported_claims: Claims the document has no information on expert-judgment replacement; the document does use expert judgement as a benchmark (§9, §10) though not as replacement.
review_comment: The duty is conditional: it applies only if validation results are unsatisfactory and expert judgement replaces results or parameters. The document does not replace outputs with expert judgement (it applies a 0,9 factor in §5.1, which is a model calibration, not an expert replacement), so the condition is arguably not triggered. 'None' is defensible but the conditional nature should have been noted, and the proposal merely restates the regulation.

The regulation says breaches of risk appetite „უნდა გახდეს მოდელის გამოყენების შეზღუდვის ან შეჩერების საფუძველი“; document.txt has no such trigger (§12 only covers quarterly reporting and updates). 'None' is right, but this is mainly an internal governance duty, so whether a supervisory application must restate it is doubtful. The proposal ('ბანკმა დაუყოვნებლივ') adds immediacy that the regulation does not state.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence treats §6.1 as acknowledging a consent requirement for the model's use; §6.1 only ties the full internal validation to consent. 'Rationale' that the gap is about 'risk assessment basis' is a minor point.
review_comment: The decisive facts are §2 „მოდელი გამოიყენება ბანკის საკრედიტო პროცესში 2021 წლის 1 ივნისიდან“ and §3.1 (income assessment under №44/04), set against art10/p1/sა, which requires prior NBG consent for exactly this model type; use began without consent while §6.1 says the validation follows consent. The system misses this conflict and proposes only a wording tweak to the validation clause, which does not fix it.

review_unsupported_claims: Section marker '§—' for the table quote; the 'terminology' point is a formality.
review_comment: The regulation requires a function responsible for development, testing, use and related risks, not the label 'დაცვის პირველი ხაზი'. The §1 table names „მოდელის შემმუშავებელი | RAMD“ and an owner (retail director) and risk owner, so the function exists. Demanding the exact term is too strict.

review_unsupported_claims: Treats sensitivity analysis as the measure of 'risk identification'.
review_comment: The document identifies some risks (§5.4 limitations, §7 overshoot of 21,4%–24,6%, §11.1 „სხვა ცვლადების მიმართ მგრძნობელობის ანალიზი არ ჩატარებულა“) but the critical assessment is thin: no independent validation yet (§6.1). Partial is defensible. The proposal only adds a generic 'ბანკი ვალდებულია' sentence, which fixes nothing concrete.

The document shows testing of accuracy (§7 R², MAPE, bias; §9 expert comparison) and §8.2 admits the Random Forest logic is not interpretable, so logic/technical-content checking is missing; bias (გადახრა) is covered by the median error row. The proposal ('გამოყენებული უნდა იქნეს განსაზღვრული პროცედურები') is an empty placeholder.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence quotes for §3.1, §5.1, §5.3, §5.4 are empty; claims no industry-practice reference although §8.1 says the result 'შეესაბამება მსჯელობას მსგავსი მოდელების საერთაშორისო პრაქტიკას'; the 'theory' reference to published research is conditional ('ასეთის არსებობის შემთხვევაში').
review_comment: The document documents structure (§5.1), assumptions (§5.3), limits (§5.4) and cites international practice only for R² (§8.1: „შეესაბამება მსგავსი მოდელების საერთაშორისო პრაქტიკას“); no published research and no comparison with alternative theories. Partial is right, but the evidence is empty quotes and misses §8.1. The proposal repeats §3.1 and just restates the regulation.

review_unsupported_claims: Empty quotes for §5.1 and §5.2; 'missing' (data quality procedures) belongs to p4/p6, not this obligation.
review_comment: The obligation is that data be suitable for the model and fit the methodology. §4 lists sources and §5.3 states the assumption that transfers reflect income, but there is no assessment of relevance (e.g. the target is declared income, only a floor per §5.3, and the data span is 2017–2020). Partial is fair, but the stated gap is data-quality procedures, a different duty, and the proposal asserts compliance without evidence.

review_unsupported_claims: Says the bank only 'indicated' external sources, implying credit bureau data was not from the model user; the document gives no description of how data from the Credit Bureau and Revenue Service were obtained or adjusted. Proxy variables not addressed at all.
review_comment: §4 lists external sources („საკრედიტო საინფორმაციო ბიურო“, „შემოსავლების სამსახური“) but does not describe or analyse how they were obtained, matched or corrected, nor the limits; the target variable (declared income, §5.3 'ქვედა ზღვარი') is effectively a proxy and is not analysed as one. The proposal copies the table and adds a bare requirement sentence without any content.

review_unsupported_claims: Rationale says 'არ არის ჩატარებული ანალიზი', but the duty is triggered only by a difference between model and benchmark, and the document shows the model clearly outperforms the benchmark (MAPE 25,3% vs 38,2%), so little to explain. Also the rationale implies a gap in analysis while §10.1 only reports the benchmark result.
review_comment: §10.1 gives the benchmark („ექსპერტული მატრიცა“) and its MAPE „38,2%“, and §7 gives the model's test MAPE of 25,3%, so the comparison is made and the difference is visible. Nothing, however, analyses why the results differ (e.g. where the matrix fails), so 'partial' is defensible, and arguably this ongoing-monitoring duty is a validation matter not required to be spelled out in the application. The proposal is a fabrication: it states „ჩატარდა დამატებითი ანალიზი“ although the document records no such analysis.

The regulation requires consideration of 'ყველა იმ ფაქტორის', while §3.2 says 'გადახდისუნარიანობის დეტალური ანალიზი არ ტარდება', so the conflict is real. The proposal keeps the 150% collateral-only route, which still conflicts with art3/p1 and p2 (analysis is required for every loan), so it does not cure the problem.

review_unsupported_claims: The evidence says the 150% rule means the decision rests on collateral alone; this is a fair inference from §3.2's second sentence.
review_comment: §3.2 states 'გადაწყვეტილება შეიძლება ეფუძნებოდეს უზრუნველყოფის ღირებულებას' and drops the analysis, against 'არ უნდა ეფუძნებოდეს მხოლოდ' in the regulation. The proposal text only restates the regulation and does not say to delete or rewrite §3.2, and its explanation claims a deletion that the text does not carry out.
§3.3 allows a total of 'არ უნდა აღემატებოდეს 12 თვეს', while the regulation says 'ჯამურად არ უნდა აჭარბებდეს 6 თვეს'. The proposal sets the cap at 6 months.

review_unsupported_claims: The regulation_text field contains both the 2020 (15-year) and the 2021 (10-year) versions of the rule, a stray fragment 'იპოთეკური სესხის შემთხვევაში:', and an evidence section marker '§—' with no clause number. The evidence quote is the Annex 1 table row, which does exist in the document.
review_comment: The Annex 1 row 'იპოთეკური სესხი უცხოურ ვალუტაში... მაქსიმალური ვადა: 15 წელი' conflicts with 'არაუმეტეს 10 (ათი) წელი'. The proposal fixes the row to 10 years but omits the transitional rule mentioned in the gold fix.

review_unsupported_claims: The evidence section marker is '§—' with no clause number, though the quoted Annex 1 row exists.
review_comment: Annex 1 sets 'უძრავი ქონებით უზრუნველყოფილი სამომხმარებლო სესხი | მაქსიმალური ვადა: 15 წელი' against the regulation's 'არაუმეტეს 10 (ათი) წელი'. The proposal sets 10 years.

review_unsupported_claims: The evidence is labelled [full] although the verdict is contradicts. The rationale also says 'რეგულაციით დადგენილ 4-წლიან ვადას' correctly, so the claims themselves are accurate.
review_comment: §4.4 says 'გამოიყენება 5-წლიანი ვადა' while the regulation says '4 (ოთხი) წელი'. The proposal uses the regulation's wording.

The regulation excludes owners of real estate when the loan purpose is buying that property ('თუ სესხის მიზნობრიობას ამ უძრავი ქონების შეძენა წარმოადგენს'), and the document has no scope exclusions at all (§1.3 says the policy covers all retail loans). The proposal copies the regulatory text and talks about 'დებულების მოთხოვნები', which is awkward wording for a bank policy, and the heading 3.7 is a guess.

review_unsupported_claims: The 'missing' text and the rationale treat the policy as lacking a procedure for classifying business-purpose loans. The regulation requires the financial analysis for that classification, not a separate policy section.
review_comment: The regulation is a definition ('სამეწარმეო მიზნობრიობით გაცემული სესხი'), and the policy covers consumer, mortgage and auto loans and is silent on business-purpose classification, so 'none' is defensible. The gold label instead flags the definitions of grace period and restructured loans (§2.1, §2.2), which the system missed, and the proposed new §6.3 is unrelated to that gap.

The regulation says requirements must be met 'სესხის დამტკიცების მომენტში ... არსებული ინფორმაციის მიხედვით', and I found no clause in the policy on the point in time at which information is assessed. The proposal copies the regulatory text, which says 'ამ დებულებით' (this Order), so it is not adapted to a bank policy; the heading 3.6 is a guess.

review_unsupported_claims: The regulation_text field carries two versions of art3/p7 (2020 and a later one with 'საყურადღებო მოდიფიკაცია'), and the obligation drops the first half ('გაცემული სესხით ... დაიფაროს'). The rationale and missing say the policy has no 'ჯამური ვალდებულებების მოცულობის ზრდა' limit, which matches my search.
review_comment: The policy has no rule that refinancing or restructuring must not increase total obligations; §3.4 only covers re-assessment of PTI. The gold label is about extending the re-assessment to significantly modified loans, which the system did not raise; the proposal adds 'საყურადღებო მოდიფიკაცია' but is placed as a new 3.1, which clashes with the existing numbering.

§4.1 says 'PTI და LTV ზღვრული მაჩვენებლები განისაზღვრება დებულების დანართებით' but only by reference, and the policy has no Annex 2 limit rule or ban on issuing above the LTV limit, so 'none' on the LTV ban is defensible (at most partial given §4.1). The gold label concerns the §4.1 exception allowing PTI to exceed the limit by 10 percentage points, which this finding does not address.

The policy is for retail loans (§1.3) and has no clause limiting combined payments of business and non-business loans to 'დანართი №1-ით განსაზღვრულ სესხის მომსახურების კოეფიციენტს'. §2.3 defines PTI over total monthly obligations but sets no such cap, so 'none' is acceptable. The proposal repeats the regulation verbatim.

Nothing in the policy deals with loans for buying, building or renovating property 'გაქირავების მიზნით' or with the 'ნარჩენ თანხაზე' rule. The finding stands, although the duty is mainly for the borrower and the proposal is a verbatim copy.

review_unsupported_claims: The obligation turns 'გამოიყენოს ... და, გონივრულობის ფარგლებში, განსაზღვროს' into a plain duty to use market averages. This is acceptable as it applies only when no data-based model is used (art6/p4 lead-in), a condition the obligation omits.
review_comment: §5.1 and §5.2 deal with income proof, and §5.2 lets a declaration alone suffice for consumer loans up to 10 000 GEL, while 'ბაზარზე ... საშუალო შემოსავლები, მომგებიანობის მაჩვენებლები' appear nowhere. The duty applies only in the no-model route, so the document has some income assessment but not this element, making 'partial' fairer than 'none'; the proposal drops the condition for this route.

review_unsupported_claims: The obligation reduces the definition of 'რესტრუქტურიზებული სესხი' to the last sentence about financial-difficulty rules, dropping the definition itself (NBG risk-category/ECL rule or terms changed because of financial difficulty). The rationale says §3.4 'partially' meets the requirement, but §3.4 deals with PTI re-assessment, not with how financial difficulty is assessed. The proposal puts a made-up duty into §3.4.
review_comment: §2.2 defines restructured loans by the 2017 'აქტივების კლასიფიკაციის წესი' (№117/04) and not the ECL rule, so the definition in the policy is outdated against 'ფინანსური ინსტრუმენტების რისკის კატეგორიებისა და მოსალოდნელი საკრედიტო ზარალის განსაზღვრის წესი'. §2.2 also states 'სხვა სახის მოდიფიცირებულ სესხებს არ განსაზღვრავს', which is the gap the gold label (D12-02) points to; the system's 'partial' on financial-difficulty rules misses it.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says the policy sets a 'stricter' 15-year term than the regulation's 20 years and that 15 'შეესაბამება' the 20-year limit. This is wrong: the Annex 1 row on FX mortgages with different-currency income (15 years) is a case ruled by art3/p6/sა.ბ, whose cap is 10 years. The finding compares it with the wrong sub-item (sა.ა, the 20-year rule). The proposed 20-year row for Lari mortgages invents a limit and a 'PTI' condition in the table.
review_comment: The policy has no row for Lari mortgages or same-currency FX mortgages up to '20 (ოცი) წელი', so that element is missing, and the Annex 1 row ('15 წელი') for FX mortgages with different-currency income and the row for real-estate-secured consumer loans ('15 წელი') exceed the 10-year caps in sა.ბ/sბ. The system treated the 15-year row as compliant when gold D12-14/15 says it is a breach, and its proposal keeps the 15-year consumer row, so it leaves the main violation in place.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says the bank 'defined documents for income confirmation' and the evidence calls §5.1 and §5.2 'partial'. They address income proof but not the no-model route; §5.2 allows a declaration alone, which sits badly with the duty to establish the business area and income volume.
review_comment: The regulation requires, without a data model, that the lender 'უნდა დაადგინოს მსესხებლის საქმიანობის სფერო და შემოსავლის მოცულობა', but §5.2 says 'საკმარისია მსესხებლის დეკლარაცია; დამატებითი დოკუმენტი ან ბანკის შიდა მეთოდოლოგიით შემოწმება არ მოითხოვება' for loans up to 10 000 GEL, which conflicts rather than merely omits. The proposal appends the duty to §5.1 but leaves §5.2 untouched, so the conflict stays.

The regulation asks the lender to request income records 'და უზრუნველყოს ასლების შენახვა'. Neither §5.1 nor §5.2 mentions requesting income records or keeping copies, so 'partial' overstates what §5.1 covers (it covers payslip/statement proof, not records or retention). §5.2 also removes any further document request for small loans; the proposal adds the duty in plain words.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says §5.3 allows a scoring model but 'prior agreement with the NBG' is not reflected; that is accurate, but it understates the problem because the document sets a different approval route.
review_comment: §5.3 says 'მოდელი ინერგება ბანკის დირექტორატის დამტკიცების შემდეგ', which makes internal approval the only gate, against 'სავალდებულოა ... წინასწარი შეთანხმება ეროვნულ ბანკთან'. The proposal adds the NBG duty but keeps the sentence on Directorate approval, which is awkward though not contradictory.

review_unsupported_claims: The evidence cites §7.1 (internal approval by the credit committee), which only loosely relates to the duty to send procedures to the NBG; the system calls it 'partial' although nothing in the document is partly compliant. The proposal text runs the §7.1 text into the 'დანართი 1' heading, copying a parsing artefact.
review_comment: The document nowhere says that policies must be given to the NBG '10 (ათი) სამუშაო დღით ადრე' before use; §7.1 deals only with internal approval and the 2-year review. So the gap is real, but it is 'none', not 'partial'.

review_unsupported_claims: The obligation drops the 'სულ მცირე' list and reduces it to one item (borrower-definition criteria). The 'missing' text invents examples ('ასაკი, მოქალაქეობა') that the regulation does not require, and the proposal copies them. The regulation's term is 'მსესხებელთა (მათ შორის, საოჯახო მეურნეობა) განსაზღვრის კრიტერიუმები', which the policy partly handles.
review_comment: §2.3 and §3.1 cover household treatment for PTI, and the policy does set income proof (§5), restructuring (§3.4) and PTI/LTV references (§4.1), but it has no criteria on loan purpose types or on how borrowers are defined. 'Partial' fits, but demanding age and citizenship goes beyond the regulation's text, so the proposal invents requirements.

review_unsupported_claims: The obligation turns a supervisory power of the NBG (art8/p1 lead-in: 'ეროვნული ბანკი უფლებამოსილია') into a duty of the lender. The evidence ties §6.1 to risk assessment but §6.1 says nothing relevant to GRAPE or NBG assessment. The proposal adds an invented duty on the RCD.
review_comment: The regulation reads 'ეროვნული ბანკი უფლებამოსილია: ... გაითვალისწინოს რისკების შეფასებაში', which is a power of the regulator and does not create a lender duty, so there is nothing for a bank policy to comply with. The finding should be dropped, not marked 'partial'.

Clause 9.1 cites '2018 წლის 9 ივლისის № 154/04 ბრძანებით დამტკიცებული ეთიკის ... კოდექსით', while the regulation requires '2021 წლის 2 თებერვლის №13/04'. The quote is accurate and the citation is outdated, so 'contradicts' is right. The proposal corrects the order number and keeps the internal ethics code.

review_unsupported_claims: The obligation says the NBG-set deadline is 'განუსაზღვრელი' (undefined/unlimited) and 'მინიმუმ 6 თვე', which garbles the regulation, where NBG sets the term (min. 6 months). The finding then treats this as a duty for the bank to apply within 6 months, which the regulation does not say.
review_comment: The rule is NBG's own procedure: it sets the term ('განუსაზღვრავს ვადას (მინიმუმ 6 თვე)'). The bank's duty to apply for consent is covered by 8.1 'გამოყენება დასაშვებია მხოლოდ საქართველოს ეროვნული ბანკის თანხმობის მიღების შემდეგ' and 8.2, so no gap exists at policy level and the proposed 6-month clause is invented.

review_unsupported_claims: Says the document has no reference to justifying a change; 8.3 does cover notifying NBG of changes and annual updates, though not the justification and error-analysis element.
review_comment: The regulation requires 'დაასაბუთოს ამ ცვლილების საჭიროება და შეცდომების ანალიზის საფუძველზე აჩვენოს ... უპირატესობა'. Clause 8.3 says 'მოდელის ყოველი მნიშვნელოვანი ცვლილება წინასწარ ეცნობება ეროვნულ ბანკს' but has no justification or superiority-demonstration element, so the finding is partial, not none. The gold label says the policy complies at policy level, and 8.2 (application per Art. 11) arguably covers it, so this is at most a minor gap and the system overstated it.

review_unsupported_claims: Claims the document mentions materiality in the scope section but does not link it to ranking. Clause 1.3.1 does mention 'მატერიალური რისკის პოზიცია', and 1.4.1 mentions 'პოტენციური მატერიალური გავლენა', but neither is about ranking.
review_comment: Clause 5.2.1 states 'ყველა მოდელი ექვემდებარება სრულ შიდა ვალიდაციას ყოველწლიურად, ერთიანი მეთოდოლოგიით ... მიუხედავად მოდელის ტიპისა და დანიშნულებისა', which directly conflicts with the duty to rank models by risk and match validation intensity. 'none' understates it; the system missed 5.2.1. The proposal adds ranking but does not fix the uniform-validation rule.

review_unsupported_claims: Claims the document has no specific requirement to document the testing method and interpretation; 4.2.1, 4.4 and 5.4.1 partly cover documentation, but not for validation test method and interpretation.
review_comment: Clause 5.3.4 describes comparison and back-testing but never says 'არჩეული ტესტირების მეთოდი და შედეგების ინტერპრეტაცია უნდა იყოს დოკუმენტირებული'; 5.4.1 requires a final conclusion and 11.1 requires archiving validation documentation, which partly covers it. The real gap per gold is independent replication (5.3.2 'შერჩევითი მიმოხილვა') and override governance (4.6.1 'მიზეზის მითითებით'), which the system did not identify.

review_unsupported_claims: The obligation omits the specific order (№215/04) and the microbank limb, and the document does not mention corporate governance codes at all; the claim of absence is correct but the obligation is imprecise.
review_comment: The document names no corporate governance code. Clause 3.4.1(გ) says only that internal audit 'აფასებს ... დებულებასთან შესაბამისობას', which is not a corporate governance code requirement, so 'none' is right. The proposal adds the microbank limb, which does not apply to a commercial bank (სს 'ალაზანი ბანკი' is a commercial bank), and omits the order number.

review_unsupported_claims: Says the policy has no own-data testing requirement; correct. Says the policy 'describes the requirement to receive information from the third party', which is true of 7.1.2 only at purchase.
review_comment: 7.1.2 requires the vendor to provide documentation, but nothing covers the case where it is 'არ არის ხელმისაწვდომი' or requires testing on the bank's own data before purchase. 7.1.3 provides validation after purchase, not pre-purchase own-data testing, so the gap is real.

The document has no mention of deviation/bias (გადახრა) procedures; 9.2 only bans direct use of protected attributes ('სქესი, ეთნიკური წარმომავლობა, რელიგია') and refers to guide EG-01. That is not 'სახელმძღვანელო მითითებების, წესებისა და პროცედურების დადგენა' for bias identification and mitigation, so 'none' is right and matches the gold gap.

review_unsupported_claims: Rationale says the policy addresses data quality standards and testing, which is true, but it does not note that 4.3.1 'დროულობის' (timeliness) is a data-quality dimension that touches the topic.
review_comment: 4.3.1 lists 'დროულობის' (timeliness) as a data-quality requirement, but nothing requires control or elimination of outdated data whose trend no longer matches current conditions ('მოძველებული მონაცემების ... კონტროლი და აღმოფხვრა'). Timeliness is only a loose neighbour, so 'none' is defensible, and it fits the gold gap (no Art. 9¹ content at all).

review_unsupported_claims: The evidence quote for §7.1.3 is empty („“) and cannot be verified. The finding says detailed 'technical and procedural' requirements for validating purchased models are missing, but the regulation only requires the policy to describe the necessary requirements, and 7.1.3 refers to Chapter 5, which contains them.
review_comment: 7.1.3 says 'შეძენილი მოდელის შიდა ვალიდაცია ტარდება ამ პოლიტიკის მე-5 თავის შესაბამისად. ვალიდაცია შეიძლება შესრულდეს ბანკის ვალიდაციის ჯგუფის ან დამოუკიდებელი მესამე მხარის მიერ', and 5.1.1 extends validation to purchased models. This describes both the internal and the third-party validation and the requirements, so the finding demands more than Art. 3(3). The proposal adds only a vague 'technical and procedural requirements' sentence.

review_unsupported_claims: Treats documentation as a missing component of risk assessment, but the document has no use-risk assessment at all (5.2.1 applies uniform validation), so 'partial' implies a risk-assessment process that does not exist.
review_comment: The regulation lists documentation as a component of model-use risk assessment inside the ranking methodology. The document has no ranking or use-risk assessment (5.2.1 'ერთიანი მეთოდოლოგიით ... მიუხედავად მოდელის ტიპისა და დანიშნულებისა'), so this sub-item is absent, not partially met. The quoted 4.2.1 and 5.3.2 are real but concern development and verification, and the proposal bolts a sentence onto the development clause 4.2.1, which is the wrong place.

review_unsupported_claims: Cites only 4.4.1 and misses 5.3.3, which covers ongoing monitoring and benchmark comparison; the claim that no trigger on new information exists is largely true.
review_comment: Clause 4.4.1 'ამოწმებს მოდელის სიზუსტეს ... მგრძნობელობას' and 5.3.1 run sensitivity tests, and 5.3.3 requires quarterly monitoring, but nothing requires re-running the development-stage tests 'ახალი ინფორმაციის მიღებისას'. Partial fits, though the gold gaps on this article (replication, override justification) are different problems.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence for §10.1 is an empty quote („“). The finding says 10.1 does not mention documentation of build/validation/update, but 10.1 does cover 'დოკუმენტაციის სისრულე' and 'მოდელის გამოყენებისა და შიდა ვალიდაციის პროცესებს'.
review_comment: Clause 10.1 has internal audit assess 'დოკუმენტაციის სისრულე', which covers documentation generally, but it does not name the build, validation and update processes. The second sentence of Art. 7(2), assessing operating systems and data management, is not in the obligation or the document. Partial is reasonable and the proposal targets the gap.

review_unsupported_claims: Says the document lacks the 'all three lines positive assessment' condition; 4.5.1 requires the validation conclusion and committee consent but not first- or third-line sign-off. It misses the real defect: the approver is not independent of the lines. Also the obligation omits the senior-management rule for supervisory models, though 8.1 gives the directorate that role.
review_comment: Under 3.3.1 the committee is chaired by the CRO (second line) and includes the head of RAMD, which houses the validation team (3.5.1), so approval under 4.5.1 'მოდელების კომიტეტის თანხმობის შემდეგ' comes from a body inside the lines of defence, which conflicts with 'დაცვის ხაზებისაგან დამოუკიდებელმა'. The system flagged 'partial' for missing qualifications and sign-offs and did not see this conflict; the proposal keeps the CRO-led committee, so it does not fix the independence defect.

review_unsupported_claims: The finding claims the regulation requires the third party to decide suitability. The text 'უნდა განისაზღვროს' is passive: it does not say who decides, and its logic ('ამის შემდეგ') points to the model user. The proposal would impose a duty on the vendor that the regulation does not impose.
review_comment: The regulation says 'ამის შემდეგ უნდა განისაზღვროს, არის თუ არა მოდელი ... მიზანშეწონილი' with no named actor, and clause 7.1.2 'მოწოდებული ინფორმაციის საფუძველზე ბანკი იღებს გადაწყვეტილებას, შეესაბამება თუ არა მოდელი ბანკის პროდუქტებს' matches it. The finding misread the passive voice and calls compliance a gap; the real gaps on this article (own-data testing, vendor test results) are untouched.

review_unsupported_claims: Cites only 7.1.1 and misses 7.1.3 and 5.1.1 (validation of purchased models), though neither applies a risk-based approach; 'partial' implies some risk-based review exists.
review_comment: Nothing in the document requires a risk-based review of purchased models; 7.1.3 applies the Chapter 5 validation, which per 5.2.1 is uniform ('მიუხედავად მოდელის ტიპისა და დანიშნულებისა'), the opposite of a risk-based approach. 7.1.1 gives ownership only. The gap matches the gold (no risk-based review of purchased models), so 'none' is better than 'partial'.

review_unsupported_claims: Rationale says that mentioning data quality incidents 'partially corresponds' to bias monitoring. 6.2 'მონაცემთა ხარისხის ინციდენტებს' concerns data quality (completeness, accuracy, etc.), not bias (გადახრა), so it is a stretch to treat it as partial coverage.
review_comment: The document never mentions გადახრა/bias monitoring; 6.2 lists 'მონაცემთა ხარისხის ინციდენტებს' and 9.2 only bans direct protected attributes, neither of which is monitoring of bias identified during data processing. The cited clause is unrelated to bias, so 'none' fits better than 'partial', which agrees with the gold gap (no Art. 9¹ content). The proposal bolts a bias sentence onto the monitoring report clause, which is a workable but thin fix.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence quote is empty („“) and cites no clause; the claim that the application was submitted 'only later' is correct, but the proposal text invents 'ეროვნული ბანკის წინასწარი თანხმობის მოლოდინში' as a status and rewrites M-002 as not yet in use, which contradicts the register's own 'წარმოებაში, 01.06.2021'.
review_comment: Document states M-002 'წარმოებაში, 01.06.2021' while 'განაცხადი წარდგენილია 10.08.2021, განხილვის პროცესშია', i.e. used without prior consent, which conflicts with 'წინასწარ თანხმობას'. The verdict matches the gold; the empty evidence quote is a defect, and the proposal rewrites the register entry to a state that is not factual instead of requiring a stop/limit of use and the internal validation.

review_unsupported_claims: Obligation says 'განუსაზღვრელი ვადის' (indefinite period), but the regulation says NBG 'განუსაზღვრავს ვადას (მინიმუმ 6 თვე)' i.e. NBG sets a term of at least 6 months; rationale says the duty arises 'after obtaining status' while the regulation puts the duty during the term set for achieving compliance and applying for consent.
review_comment: The obligation garbles 'განუსაზღვრავს ვადას' (sets a deadline) into 'განუსაზღვრელი ვადა' (indefinite term), and it is an NBG-triggered, case-specific process duty that a model register would not contain. The gold concerns M-002 consent and validation, not this paragraph.

The duty to document model theory/structure belongs to model development documentation; document.txt is an inventory (it lists 'მეთოდი' per model only). The system itself notes it is a register, so a gap here is not meaningful, and adding a theory section to a register is misplaced.

'სათანადო დოკუმენტირება' at the build stage is a development-process duty; a model register is not where build documentation lives. The system admits 'დოკუმენტი არის მოდელების ჩამონათვალი', so flagging it as a gap is a scope error.
Data suitability and quality assessment for model building is documented in development files, not in an inventory. The system acknowledges 'რეესტრი', so the gap finding is out of scope.

review_unsupported_claims: Obligation drops the first sentence's purpose but is otherwise faithful; the proposal's 'დაემატა ... სავალდებულო კომპონენტები' mirrors policy text, not register content.
review_comment: How the internal validation process defines limits and assumptions is a validation-methodology duty; the register only records dates ('ბოლო ვალიდაცია'). Flagging absence of process description in an inventory is not a real gap.

review_unsupported_claims: Misses that the register shows third-party models with weaker treatment (M-005 validation only 'მომწოდებლის დოკუმენტაციის მიმოხილვა', M-007 'არ ჩატარებულა – მიღებულია მომწოდებლის ვალიდაციის ანგარიში', M-005 'ალტერნატიული გეგმა: არ არსებობს'); proposal adds 'მესაკუთრეობის, ტესტირებისა და მუდმივი მონიტორინგის' content not in the regulation sentence.
review_comment: 'უფრო მკაცრ სტანდარტებს' is a general policy-level standard that a register cannot state; the 'none' finding is out of scope. The register's own entries (M-007 'არ ჩატარებულა') would be the real evidence of non-compliance, which the system did not identify.

Monitoring of identifiable bias in data processing ('გადახრის მონიტორინგი') is an operational process duty; a model inventory does not carry it. Also the provision is dated 2022-05-03, after this 2021-era register, so its absence is not a gap.

The obligation repeats the regulation's 'სოციალურად ნეიტრალური შედეგისთვის პრიორიტეტის მინიჭება' faithfully. This is a model-design ethics duty that an inventory (one row per model with owner, method, status) does not carry, and the provision is dated 2022-05-03, after this 2021 register, so a 'none' gap is not meaningful.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence quote is real, but the evidence omits 'მიზანი' (the 'დანიშნულება / გამოყენება' field) and 'სეგმენტი'. The 'missing' list claims 'შექმნის თარიღი' and 'მონაცემთა წყარო' are absent, yet the register carries 'წარმოებაში, 01.06.2021' and a purpose field. The obligation turns the list into a mandatory set while dropping the 'ასეთის არსებობის შემთხვევაში' qualifiers on expert view, benchmark model and sensitivity analysis, and 'სასურველია, სტატიის სახით'. The proposal inserts placeholders and again rewrites the status to 'წინასწარი თანხმობის მოლოდინში', which contradicts 'წარმოებაში, 01.06.2021'.
