review_comment: The content of an application submitted to the NBG is not something a model register must contain; the register itself says 'განაცხადი წარდგენილია 10.08.2021'. The real problem with M-002 is production use before consent, which is covered by finding 1, not by this one.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence quote is empty and cites no clause. M-002 has no NBG consent yet, so the annual-update duty has not started and 'partial' is wrong.
review_comment: The duty to update a supervisory model at least annually ('განაახლოს საზედამხედველო მოდელი მინიმუმ ყოველწლიურად') applies to an approved and used supervisory model, and the register states M-002 is only 'განხილვის პროცესშია'. The gold issue is the missing consent and validation, not update cadence.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence quote is empty and cites no clause. A notification duty for interventions cannot be breached before consent exists; 'partial' implies something is met, but nothing is.
review_comment: Informing the NBG of 'ყველა მნიშვნელოვანი ჩარევა' is an ongoing procedural duty, not register content. The gold concerns M-002 being in production without prior consent and without internal validation.

review_unsupported_claims: The regulation lists techniques 'მათ შორის' (including) and says 'გამოყენებული უნდა იქნეს, მათ შორის, შემდეგი ტექნიკა'; the obligation drops the open-list wording. The system claims M-005 is a 'შავი ყუთის' model from 'ნეირონული ქსელი (საკუთრებითი)', which is reasonable, but the provision is dated 2022-05-03, after this 2021 register.
review_comment: Explainability techniques are a model-development and validation matter; the register only lists 'მეთოდი'. The provision came into force on 2022-05-03, so the 2021 register cannot be judged against it, and 'partial' is wrong because nothing here meets the requirement at all.

review_unsupported_claims: Claims annual validation is 'monitoring element' – annual validation is not post-launch risk monitoring. The register has no monitoring information, so 'partial' is too generous.
review_comment: The quote 'ყველა მოდელი ექვემდებარება სრულ ვალიდაციას ყოველწლიურად' exists in the note, but validation is a different duty from 'მოდელის რისკის მონიტორინგი' after launch. Nothing in the register covers monitoring, so 'none' fits better than 'partial'; the proposal merely copies the regulation sentence into a register note.

The quote 'ყველა მოდელი ექვემდებარება სრულ ვალიდაციას ყოველწლიურად' is real, but whether validation checks results against the build purpose is validation-methodology content, not something an inventory records. The register logs only dates ('ბოლო ვალიდაცია'), so a 'partial' gap is not meaningful.

review_unsupported_claims: Evidence is real for M-005 and M-007, but the finding does not say that M-007 had no validation at all ('არ ჩატარებულა'), and the proposal merely rewrites M-007 to say the vendor report 'მოიცავს' all required items, which is invented and unverified. M-011's pending status is not mentioned. The 'გამოიყენოს საკუთარი მონაცემები' clause is not in the obligation.
review_comment: The register shows third-party models accepted on thin evidence: M-005 'მომწოდებლის დოკუმენტაციის მიმოხილვა', M-007 'არ ჩატარებულა – მიღებულია მომწოდებლის ვალიდაციის ანგარიში', so it is unclear whether the vendor supplied the detailed description, test results and limits required by art9/p4. 'partial' is defensible, but the proposal fabricates that the report contains the items.

review_unsupported_claims: Both quoted evidence strings are real, but neither shows receipt of periodic third-party test results. 'მომწოდებლის დოკუმენტაციის მიმოხილვა' (M-005) and 'მიღებულია მომწოდებლის ვალიდაციის ანგარიში' (M-007) are one-off documentation or validation reviews, so the claim that they 'partially' meet the duty is unsupported. The proposal fabricates a fact for M-007: 'რეგულარულად მიღებულია მომწოდებლის პერიოდული ტესტირების შედეგები' contradicts 'არ ჩატარებულა' and is not supported by anything in the register. The obligation drops the second element (checking the results against 'საკუთარი რისკის აპეტიტთან'), though this is a minor omission.
review_comment: The register records only single events ('ბოლო ვალიდაცია: 15.09.2021 (მომწოდებლის დოკუმენტაციის მიმოხილვა)' for M-005, 'არ ჩატარებულა – მიღებულია მომწოდებლის ვალიდაციის ანგარიში' for M-007) and nothing about regular receipt of periodic test results or a check against risk appetite. 'none' fits better than 'partial'. The proposal does not fix the gap; it asserts regular receipt that the register does not support.

review_unsupported_claims: The proposal text reproduces the clause rather than adding anything about the tree-model rationale. The §6.2 quote is real, but the claim that it bears on the sensitivity-analysis/time-period element is a stretch, because back-testing is not the same as the period/sensitivity assessment.
review_comment: §4.3 „მგრძნობელობისა და სტაბილურობის ტესტირება ექსტრემალური მნიშვნელობების პირობებში არ ჩატარებულა“ is real, and it conflicts with the requirement to assess the effect of assumptions and sensitivity. Note that art5/p10 concerns the first line (the developer), while this is a validation report, so scope is only loosely met. The citation of §6.2 as 'partial' evidence is weak.

The regulation says „გამოყენებული უნდა იქნეს ცვლადების ექსტრემალური მნიშვნელობები“, and §4.3 states „არ ჩატარებულა“ because trees are robust. The proposal is poor: it says testing must be done 'despite' gradient boosting being robust, which restates the document's own rationale as a fact instead of fixing it.

review_unsupported_claims: The §3.2 quote is cited as 'contradicts', but it shows data-quality checks that are not in conflict with the requirement; it is irrelevant to the re-run. The proposal asserts that the validation team re-ran the model, which is a fabricated fact.
review_comment: §5.1 „მოდელის ხელახალი გაშვება ვალიდაციის ჯგუფის მიერ ... არ განხორციელებულა“ directly contradicts „მეორე ხაზმა ... უნდა გაუშვას მოდელი“. The proposal rewrites the document to claim the re-run happened, which is an invented fact rather than a remediation.

§1.1 „სტანდარტული მოცულობით, რომელიც ერთნაირად ვრცელდება ბანკის ყველა მოდელზე“ conflicts with proportionality by materiality and complexity. The proposal declares that scope was set proportionately, which fabricates compliance instead of prescribing the fix.

Art. 11 p5 („განაახლოს საზედამხედველო მოდელი მინიმუმ ყოველწლიურად და წარუდგინოს ეროვნულ ბანკს“) is a duty to the regulator concerning supervisory models, and it is not something an internal validation report would cover. The answer key shows no match, so the gap is not real and the proposed new section is inappropriate.

The duty to notify the National Bank of significant interventions in the supervisory model is a regulatory-communication process, not content of a validation report, and the document also makes no claim to be a supervisory model. The 'none' verdict flags a gap that is not a gap for this document type.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says the document contains 'justification of method choice and recommendations', which is true of §4.1 and §9, but neither is about justifying a change to a supervisory model.
review_comment: The duty „დაასაბუთოს ამ ცვლილების საჭიროება“ applies to the user entity when changing a supervisory model submitted to the National Bank. A validation report of a credit-scoring model has no such obligation, and the answer key has no match.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says the document does not mention alternative theories or models, but §4.1 compares gradient boosting with a reference logistic scorecard on OOT Gini (+5 pp), and §6 compares to the reference scorecard.
review_comment: §4.1 „gradient boosting-მა OOT ნიმუშზე აჩვენა Gini კოეფიციენტის 5 პროცენტული პუნქტით მაღალი მნიშვნელობა საორიენტაციო ლოგისტიკურ სკორკარდთან შედარებით“ is a comparison with an alternative approach, so the 'none' claim is false. It is also arguable that art5 p2 binds the first line (the developer), not the validation report, but the report does cover the comparison. The proposed new section is unnecessary.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says the document is not a 'model use policy', which is a scope argument, yet it still reports a gap. The proposal asserts a conditional rule rather than something a validation report would contain.
review_comment: Art. 5 p5 („აღნიშნული უნდა გახდეს ... მოდელის გამოყენების შეზღუდვის ან შეჩერების საფუძველი“) is a duty of the user entity about data-quality standards, and §3.2 reports data quality as acceptable, so there is no trigger. The system itself admits the document is a validation report, so flagging a gap is inconsistent.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale claims the document never mentions the model's influence on decision-making. §2.1 states that the score is used for 'ავტომატური დამტკიცებისა ან უარისთვის' and that 78% of applications were decided automatically, which is exactly such influence. Calling the proposal a 'new_document' is also odd.
review_comment: The regulation asks that materiality determination consider the model's potential to influence significant decisions. §2.1 („2021 წლის ივლისი–ოქტომბრის პერიოდში ავტომატურად გადაწყდა განაცხადების 78%“) supplies the facts, but the report never ties this to a materiality assessment or risk ranking, so 'partial' fits better than 'none'. The answer key has no match.

review_unsupported_claims: The obligation drops the second half of the sentence, 'მოდელის გაშვება უნდა მოხდეს შესაბამისი შეზღუდვებით'. The proposal invents a fact, that the models committee was fully informed.
review_comment: §9.1 „მოდელი შეიძლება გამოყენებულ იქნას შეზღუდვების გარეშე“ conflicts with the rule that where data have shortcomings the launch must be „შესაბამისი შეზღუდვებით“, and §1.2 shows launch on 01.07.2021 on a temporary permission before validation ended. The system saw no conflict ('none'), so its direction is wrong; the gold reasons concern launch before validation and the unrestricted rating.

The regulation says „მოდელის რისკის მნიშვნელოვანი ცვლილებები ... უნდა გახდეს მოდელის გამოყენების შეზღუდვის ან შეჩერების საფუძველი“. The document does not state this mechanism ('none' is defensible), but §9.1 „შეზღუდვების გარეშე“ despite open items (§6.2 back-testing impossible, 7.4% expert overrides) is the real problem, matching the gold reason that unresolved gaps should lead to restrictions.

review_unsupported_claims: The claim that no risks are identified is overstated: §3.3, §4.3, §5.1, §6.2, §7.2 and §8 all contain risk observations. The proposal contains a '[ჩამონათვალი]' placeholder and repeats the 'without restrictions' conclusion.
review_comment: Art. 4 p2 is an organisational duty (identify and critically assess model risks), and the validation report as a whole identifies and assesses risks (e.g. §6.1, §6.2, §8.1, recommendations R1–R3). Its weaknesses are better captured by other provisions; the answer key shows no match.

review_unsupported_claims: The §4.2 and table quotes are accurate but serve as weak 'partial' evidence. The proposal rewrites the document to claim testing was done, including extreme-value sensitivity, which is false.
review_comment: Accuracy testing is present (§6 table, Gini 0,57 vs 0,45 threshold; OOT sample), but §4.3 „ექსტრემალური მნიშვნელობების პირობებში არ ჩატარებულა“ shows the behaviour-under-changed-inputs element is missing. The proposal fabricates compliance instead of requiring the test.

review_unsupported_claims: §4.3 concerns extreme variable values, not market scenarios, so it does not support the claim that the document 'does not match the market-scenario requirement'.
review_comment: The regulation says „საჭიროების შემთხვევაში“ testing under baseline/optimistic/pessimistic scenarios, and the document contains no scenario testing at all (only OOT and reference-scorecard comparison). The extreme-value gap in §4.3 is a different element (sensitivity), so 'partial' is the wrong degree. The proposal merely copies the regulation.

review_unsupported_claims: The claim that the document does not confirm checks follow a predefined internal policy is the demand of a policy duty. The proposal invents a statement that the tests are defined in internal procedures.
review_comment: Art. 5 p6 („შიდა პოლიტიკა-პროცედურებით უნდა განსაზღვროს“) is a duty on the content of the entity's internal policy, which a validation report need not restate. §1.1 refers to POL-RM-014 and §3.2 reports the checks performed, and the answer key shows no match.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says validation is done by a separate group, but the document never states the validators' organisational independence. The proposal inverts the problem by presenting the lack of environment access as something that 'ensures independence', which is a fabricated justification.
review_comment: The document nowhere states that validation was independent of the developer and the first line, and the signature section is empty (only „10 ჯგუფი“ / „10 სკორინგის ჯგუფის ზედამხედველი)“), which is the gap the gold note D5-08 points to. §5.1 „არ აქვს წვდომა განვითარების გამოთვლით გარემოზე“ is a technical limitation, not evidence of dependence, and §5.2 relying on the developer's own comparison does show reliance on the first line. The proposal wrongly calls the lack of access a guarantee of independence.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale infers a risk-based approach from the mere fact that validation followed the policy, which §1.1 does not say. The proposal asserts that validation used a risk-based approach and then repeats the 'same standard scope for all models' wording, which contradicts risk-based validation.
review_comment: §1.1 „სტანდარტული მოცულობით, რომელიც ერთნაირად ვრცელდება ბანკის ყველა მოდელზე“ shows a uniform, not risk-based, approach, and there is no ranking or grouping of models by risk anywhere in the document. 'Partial' is too lenient, since the document affirmatively shows a non-risk-differentiated approach. The proposal paradoxically keeps the contradicting sentence.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale demands an explicit link between documentation and risk assessment, which the regulation does not require in that form. The proposal states that the team used documentation 'in the risk assessment process', which the document does not say.
review_comment: The regulation lists documentation as one component of model-use risk assessment. §1.3 shows documentation (MD-M001 v1.2) was used, but the report has no model-use risk assessment in which documentation quality is weighed, so 'partial' is defensible. The proposal just asserts a link that is not in the report.

review_unsupported_claims: The rationale says the bank 'developed a recommendation', but it was the validation group that recommended (§8.2). The claim that back-testing impossibility is 'required' for the justification is garbled.
review_comment: §8.2 „დამტკიცების ზღვრის (cut-off) შემცირებას 40 ქულით, საკრედიტო დეპარტამენტის ექსპერტული მოსაზრების საფუძველზე“ is an expert-judgement replacement with no quantitative justification, and §8.2 adds „შეიძლება განხორციელდეს მოდელის ხელახალი აგების გარეშე“, which excludes re-estimation. The document affirmatively proposes the change without the required back-testing (§6.2 says it is impossible), so this is a conflict rather than a partial. The proposal only rewrites §6.2 and does not touch the cut-off recommendation.
